title: Four tests red on main after the day's packages, fixed; the roadmap brought up to date
request: The owner: review the whole repository, then go on with the recommendation: fix the failing tests first and update the roadmap; the full gate waits for 11:50 pm.
spec: A whole-repo review found three test files failing on main and a roadmap whose status lines were days old.
plan: Rerun the test files the last full run left failing

decisions.decision: Never change a frozen campaign's manifest to fix a page
decisions.why: the memory v2 plan and the v1 result record the manifest's hash

findings.defect: Two settings the code reads were not documented
findings.scenario: DCLAB_BROWSER_CHANNEL and DCLAB_CODE_RUNS were added without a line in the example settings
findings.cause: the settings were added in two packages of the day without the example file
findings.fix: both documented with their safe default

findings.defect: The Lab page showed the memory campaigns with no objective
findings.scenario: a campaign with a question in its manifest but no objective and no report
findings.cause: the page read only an objective or a report
findings.fix: the page falls back to the campaign's question

findings.defect: Memory found its workspace folder by reading a store's own folder
findings.scenario: the storage rule refuses code outside the stores that reaches into their folders
findings.cause: the workspace folder was taken from the project store's home
findings.fix: the storage layer's files_for finds it

findings.defect: A memory test read the real pilot folder
findings.scenario: once the real pilot ran, the test's freeze was refused as a second pilot
findings.cause: the test did not point the runs folder at its own temporary folder
findings.fix: the test patches the runs folder

outcome: The four red tests pass again and the roadmap says what is built and what waits; the full gate runs at 11:50 pm.
lessons: A new setting gets its documentation line in the same change.
A test must never read the real run folders, even when none exists yet.
risks: Other files may fail in the full gate; only the files that failed last were rerun.
